PLDMDevice.description: The PLDM record of an entity, consumed by pldmd for both PLDM Type 5 (firmware components) and Type 2 (monitoring: names, ports, roles, events, thresholds). Topology supplies device identity and wiring.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the PLDMDevice entry, normally the device name followed by _PLDM.

Type.description: Identifies a PLDMDevice entity Exposes record.

UpdateableComponents.description: Firmware inventory names mapped to PLDM component identifiers for updateable components.

FWInventoryOnlyComponent.description: Firmware inventory names mapped to PLDM component identifiers for inventory-only components.

FirmwareName.description: Name of the firmware device whose component inventory is shared by this device.

NetworkAdapter.description: Name of the inventory object under the device to which its NetworkController PDR entity binds.

SensorAuxNames.description: Names for sensors the device leaves unnamed; a device Auxiliary Names PDR takes precedence. Maps auxiliary names to sensor identifiers.

EffecterAuxNames.description: Names for effecters the device leaves unnamed; a device Auxiliary Names PDR takes precedence. Maps auxiliary names to effecter identifiers.

Ports.description: Fallback mapping from sensor identifiers to port inventory names, used only when the device publishes no Port entity PDRs.

PortMaxSpeedMBps.description: Maximum port speed in megabytes per second, used for port metadata.

PortType.description: Inventory port type used for port metadata; defaults to BidirectionalPort.

SensorRoles.description: Role association names, such as primary_temperature_sensor, mapped to the sensor or effecter name as used in SensorAuxNames or EffecterAuxNames. Each role names one sensor. Values are strings because entity-manager flattens only one level.

EventIds.description: Sensor names as used in SensorAuxNames mapped to event identifier arrays, with the same ordering and semantics as SensorEventInfo.EventIds. Values are arrays of strings, not nested objects.

ImpactedComponent.description: Impacted component reported for events from this device, as in SensorEventInfo.

LoggingNamespace.description: Optional logging namespace for events from this device, as in SensorEventInfo.

UpperFatal.description: Upper fatal threshold overrides mapped by sensor auxiliary name.

UpperCritical.description: Upper critical threshold overrides mapped by sensor auxiliary name.

UpperCaution.description: Upper caution threshold overrides mapped by sensor auxiliary name.

PLDM_Policy.description: Downstream PlatformExposes record carrying a platform's PLDM T2 behaviour choices for an NvDevice firmware family.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the PLDM policy entry.

Type.description: Identifies a PLDM monitoring policy PlatformExposes record.

Kind.description: NvDevice kind identifying the firmware family to which this policy applies.

Devices.description: Device names to which this policy applies; an empty array selects all devices of Kind.

LinkStateOnNetworkAdapter.description: Bind port link-state sensors to the NetworkAdapter inventory object instead of the port.

PlugParent.description: Name of the inventory object the device's plug/cable sensors are associated to instead of the port; resolved by name by pldmd.

title: PLDM Device and Monitoring Policy Records
description: Downstream entity-manager schemas for PLDMDevice entity Exposes and PLDM_Policy PlatformExposes records consumed by pldmd.
